known_breaks.rule: |gap| > 5% of average month-end headcount and > 20 people (D-009), government and department fiscal years

t12_window.note: the trailing 12 months ending at the latest month, for each child with at least one month inside the window (D-034), so children sum exactly to their parent; partial, over its own months, for a child whose rows begin inside the window; a child that ended inside the window keeps its in-window flows and counts headcount 0 for the months after its last month (rates on a zero mean stay empty)

columns.name: parent
columns.description: parent entity key of every row in the file

columns.name: child_level
columns.description: 'department', 'agency' (DOD only) or 'subelement'

columns.name: child
columns.description: child entity key (same keys as the core cube)

columns.name: grain
columns.description: 'fy' (fiscal year) or 't12' (the trailing 12 months ending at period_last_month)

columns.name: period
columns.description: 'FYyyyy', or for t12 the last month 'YYYY-MM'

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: fiscal year of the period; null for t12

columns.name: period_first_month
columns.description: first calendar month of the period (YYYY-MM), published or not

columns.name: period_last_month
columns.description: last published month of the period up to the entity's last month: the month stocks are taken from

columns.name: months_in_period
columns.description: calendar months in the period: 1, 3 or 12

columns.name: months_published
columns.description: months of the period with a published employment file, from the entity's first month to its last

columns.name: time_basis
columns.description: 'effective': flows counted by personnel_action_effective_date_yyyymm (invariant 6)

columns.name: provisional
columns.description: the period contains any of the newest 3 months (invariant 8)

columns.name: partial
columns.description: the period has months not yet published, or months before the entity's first month or after its last

columns.name: reissued
columns.description: a month of the period changed file version since the previous manifest (revision_baseline.json); false on the first build, which is the baseline

columns.name: opm_incomplete
columns.description: a month of the period is one OPM marks incomplete for this entity (KDI-006: DOD entities and the government, Jun and Jul 2026)

columns.name: kdi_ids
columns.description: known data issue ids (pipeline/known_data_issues.csv) touching a month of the period: entity-month flags of the entity and the entities inside it, and KDI-001 when a departure of the period has a length of service treated as unknown (KDI-001, KDI-009)

columns.name: headcount
columns.description: rows in the employment file of period_last_month, as published; 0 when the entity has none that month

columns.name: hires
columns.description: accession rows effective in the period (new hires and transfers in)

columns.name: departures
columns.description: separation rows effective in the period (every code; transfers out and DRP included)

columns.name: acc_transfer_in
columns.description: hires with accession code AA + AB; the two categories partition hires

columns.name: acc_new_hire
columns.description: hires with accession code AC + AD + AE; the two categories partition hires

columns.name: sep_transfer_out
columns.description: departures with separation code SA + SB; the six categories partition departures

columns.name: sep_drp
columns.description: departures with drp_indicator = 'Y', any code: an overlay on the six categories, and with the six _nondrp columns the seventh reason

columns.name: sep_transfer_out_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SA + SB and drp_indicator not 'Y'; sep_drp plus the six _nondrp columns partition departures (the seven reasons)

columns.name: sep_quit_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SC and drp_indicator not 'Y'; sep_drp plus the six _nondrp columns partition departures (the seven reasons)

columns.name: sep_retirement_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SD + SE + SG and drp_indicator not 'Y'; sep_drp plus the six _nondrp columns partition departures (the seven reasons)

columns.name: sep_rif_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SH and drp_indicator not 'Y'; sep_drp plus the six _nondrp columns partition departures (the seven reasons)

columns.name: sep_termination_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SJ and drp_indicator not 'Y'; sep_drp plus the six _nondrp columns partition departures (the seven reasons)

columns.name: sep_other_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SL and drp_indicator not 'Y'; sep_drp plus the six _nondrp columns partition departures (the seven reasons)

columns.name: attrition_a_num
columns.description: attrition rate numerator, method A, trailing 12 months ending in period_last_month (null before the 12th month, Sep 2012, and before the entity's 12th month): departures; rate = attrition_a_num / rate_a_den

columns.name: hire_a_num
columns.description: hire rate numerator, method A, trailing 12 months ending in period_last_month (null before the 12th month, Sep 2012, and before the entity's 12th month): hires; rate = hire_a_num / rate_a_den

columns.name: rate_a_den
columns.description: shared denominator of the attrition and hire rates, method A, trailing 12 months ending in period_last_month (null before the 12th month, Sep 2012, and before the entity's 12th month): mean of the month-end headcounts of rate_a_months months; null, with null numerators and flag, when that mean is 0 (never 0/0)

columns.name: rate_a_months
columns.description: number of month-end headcounts averaged into rate_a_den

columns.name: rate_a_small_base
columns.description: rate_a_den < 30 (invariant 9): shown with a flag, never hidden; null when the rate is empty

columns.name: attrition_b_num
columns.description: attrition rate numerator, method B, fiscal year only (null at month and quarter grain); a partial fiscal year is year to date over its published months, not annualized: departures; rate = attrition_b_num / rate_b_den

columns.name: hire_b_num
columns.description: hire rate numerator, method B, fiscal year only (null at month and quarter grain); a partial fiscal year is year to date over its published months, not annualized: hires; rate = hire_b_num / rate_b_den

columns.name: rate_b_den
columns.description: shared denominator of the attrition and hire rates, method B, fiscal year only (null at month and quarter grain); a partial fiscal year is year to date over its published months, not annualized: mean of the month-end headcounts of rate_b_months months; null, with null numerators and flag, when that mean is 0 (never 0/0); fy rows only (null on t12 rows, where method A is the window itself)

columns.name: rate_b_months
columns.description: number of month-end headcounts averaged into rate_b_den

columns.name: rate_b_small_base
columns.description: rate_b_den < 30 (invariant 9): shown with a flag, never hidden; null when the rate is empty

columns.name: attrition_c_num
columns.description: attrition rate numerator, method C, annualized per period: sums times 12 / rate_c_months over its published months: departures; rate = attrition_c_num / rate_c_den

columns.name: hire_c_num
columns.description: hire rate numerator, method C, annualized per period: sums times 12 / rate_c_months over its published months: hires; rate = hire_c_num / rate_c_den

columns.name: rate_c_den
columns.description: shared denominator of the attrition and hire rates, method C, annualized per period: sums times 12 / rate_c_months over its published months: mean of the month-end headcounts of rate_c_months months; null, with null numerators and flag, when that mean is 0 (never 0/0); fy rows only (null on t12 rows, where method A is the window itself)

columns.name: rate_c_months
columns.description: number of month-end headcounts averaged into rate_c_den

columns.name: rate_c_small_base
columns.description: rate_c_den < 30 (invariant 9): shown with a flag, never hidden; null when the rate is empty

files_digest_method: sha256 of the lines '<path> <sha256>\n' for every file, sorted by path
